This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Mixtwirk''' and his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] companion were in the [[Stock Lights]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when [[Cryle Cavv]] first explained to his nephew [[Sienn Sconn]] that he wanted to steal a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The [[Mixtwirk]] tried to eavesdrop on the conversation but Cavv grabbed him by the antennae and forced the two to leave the cantina.
